author: Kusha N M
raw:
ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಕುಳಿತಿರುವ ಶಕ್ತಿನೀಡುವ ದೈವ
ತನ್ನಿರುವ ತಿಳಿಸುತಲೆ ದಾರಿ ತೋರಿಸುವ
ನಿನ್ನ ನೀನರಿತೊಡನೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯಕ್ಷನಾಗುವವ
ಭಿನ್ನತೆಯ ತೋರೆ ನಡೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: The God who sits within you and gives you strength
makes his presence known and shows you the way;
he appears the moment you know yourself;
walk on, showing no sense of separateness, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The divine within guides us and reveals itself when we come to know ourselves. Then the sense of separation from others falls away.
